edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender, making caller identity the authorization primitive of the token.
Owned constructor writes owner from msg.sender, establishing unilateral ownership.
msg.sender flows directly into the privileged owner state variable.
KDU constructor uses msg.sender as the recipient of the full minted supply.
onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable for its access check.
KDU constructor assigns the fixed total supply to _totalSupply.
KDU constructor writes the entire supply into _balances[msg.sender].
transfer forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount into _transfer.
approve forwards _msgSender(), spender and amount into _approve.
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the raised allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the lowered allowance through _approve.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping for the owner-spender pair.
totalSupply view returns the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf view returns an entry of the _balances mapping.
allowance view returns an entry of the _allowances mapping.
increaseAllowance reads the current allowance before adding.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance before subtracting.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] to validate and decrement.
safeTransfer encodes calldata and passes it to callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom encodes calldata and passes it to callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove encodes calldata and passes it to callOptionalReturn.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance, a classic integer underflow site.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
ERC20Detailed constructor stores the token name.
ERC20Detailed constructor stores the token symbol.
ERC20Detailed constructor stores the token decimals.
name view reads _name.
symbol view reads _symbol.
decimals view reads _decimals.

approve invokes _msgSender to determine the caller.

transferFrom calls into the internal _transfer routine.

safeTransferFrom delegates execution to callOptionalReturn.

KDU constructor chains into the ERC20Detailed constructor.
callOptionalReturn reaches the external low-level call on an untrusted token, the reentrancy entry point.
Control returns from the untrusted external call back into callOptionalReturn for return-data decoding.
safeTransfer transitively triggers the external call on the caller-supplied token contract.
A malicious token can re-enter approval logic while the external call is executing.

normalization_plan.reason: Temporary recipient parameter of transfer; no independent security semantics beyond its use inside the transfer function.
Temporary amount parameter of transfer; its effect is fully described by the transfer function node.
Local sender argument of _transfer, a short-lived alias of the caller or the transferred-from account.
Local recipient argument of _transfer; only meaningful inside the balance-update routine.
Local amount argument of _transfer feeding the SafeMath sub/add balance updates.
Local owner argument of _approve used only to key the allowance mapping and zero-address check.
Local spender argument of _approve used only to key the allowance mapping.
Local amount argument of _approve written straight into the allowance state variable.
Encoding argument of the wrapper; carries no state of its own outside the transfer encoding.
Encoding argument of the wrapper; its only effect is inside the encoded call data.
Token handle that becomes the low-level call target; its risk is captured by the safeTransfer function and the unsafe call node.
Raw calldata forwarded into the low-level call; its only effect is the unsafe external call.

Constructor string argument assigned directly to the _symbol state variable.
Constructor integer argument assigned directly to the _decimals state variable.
